protocol.scope: Same clean mei180TRAIN/60 repeatedly explored VAL full2s shared frozen frontend, same common65frame interiors x180; no TEST/auth read, no external samples or pretrained speech weights. Offline future ACC context.
protocol.model: Frozen previous same-seed fullcontext G, 24channel no-downsample time-conditioned predictor shared architecture; ReturnF trainable. No crosscycle bypass. Direct=1NFE, velocity/DP=5NFE. Not compute-matched.
protocol.training: New D40warmup all routes, lr.0001; all completeACCcycle20/audio10/pairedACC5, pairedMel2 + coreMSE20 (direct actualoutput; velocity conditional OT field; DP interpolant-conditioned targetdata); audioGAN.1/ACCGAN.05, contrast.5/freqgrad1/timegrad1/physicalenergy3. Noise.005 beforeF. Gaussianprior centeredonbase,sigma.2, t=sigmoid(N(.4,1)). Uniform5step Euler, no MeanFlow/JVP training. Fixedendpoint/noVALcheckpointselection.
protocol.evaluation: 3fixed draws per trainedflow, no best-of-N, metrics averaged across draw metrics NOT averaged spectrograms. Plot draw0 fixedsame4sources. Deterministic direct only1draw. Stochastic controls use SAME noise for paired and wrong/shuffled inputs.
protocol.limits: Inspired project Mel adaptation, not waveform RMFSR/MeanFlow/Stream.FM reproduction or speakeridentity proof. DP/prior ideas tested, no PASE implementation. Changed matched objective from prior experiment; old model is reference, direct is currentsame-budget control.
